name: What are the advantages of hiring a hands-on general contractor for wall tile work?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of hiring a hands-on general contractor for wall tile work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a single contractor who manages framing, drywall, and tiling ensures the wall substrate is built completely flat and plumb before a single tile is set. Tile installations often fail because walls beneath are bowed or out of square. An owner-operated contractor can re-stud walls, repair drywall, build custom shower niches, and set tiles directly without delaying the project for separate trade handoffs. They can also coordinate licensed electrical and plumbing sub-trades seamlessly, providing one reliable point of contact throughout the entire bathroom or kitchen upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor ensures framing and drywall are perfectly flat before tiling, manages any plumbing adjustments, and handles the entire project under one roof.
